name: my-deen
description: My Deen — free Islamic app: prayer times, Quran, tasbih, duas, Qibla

scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/data www/icons www/audio www/assets && cp index.html styles.css app.js praycalc.js manifest.json sw.js privacy.html www/ && cp data/duas.js data/hadiths.js www/data/ && cp assets/quran-meta.js assets/quran-full.js www/assets/ && cp icons/* www/icons/ && cp audio/azan.mp3 audio/reminder.mp3 audio/durood.mp3 audio/istighfar.mp3 audio/reminder_fajr.mp3 audio/reminder_dhuhr.mp3 audio/reminder_asr.mp3 audio/reminder_maghrib.mp3 audio/reminder_isha.mp3 audio/reminder_jumuah.mp3 www/audio/
scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
